name: Flat Lay Feed
summary: Objects arranged on a flat surface and shot from straight above: coffee, a notebook, flowers, a phone. Marble or linen fills the ground, light is soft, and props sit in neat clusters with empty space.

philosophy.core_thesis: A life laid flat on a table: choose objects, set them in order and shoot straight down so that the story reads like a diagram.
design_principles: Shoot at 90° from directly above and fill the square frame with one surface.
Use a pale ground: white marble (#F6F5F2), light oak or linen, lit by a window at 45° to the side.
Group 5 to 9 objects in odd numbers and keep 30% to 40% of the frame empty.
Repeat 1 accent colour, such as blush (#D9A7A0) or eucalyptus (#7C9A8A), in 3 props.
Align objects to the frame edge or at 90° and 45° angles, and keep 8% to 12% of the frame as a margin.
Place the hero object at one third of the frame and add a hand or a cup for scale.
Add a short lower-case caption at 14px and a row of 10 to 20 tags under the photo.
anti_patterns: Even, centred, symmetric spacing with no focal object

layout.grid_mechanics: A square frame on a 3 by 3 invisible grid; the hero object sits on a third line and props fill the cells around it.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 40% of the frame stays as bare surface; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Objects align on 0° and 90° axes; a 45° diagonal is allowed for one long object.
layout.container_geometry: Square photos with a 0px radius; a 1px #E5E2DB line between cards; props overlap by 4% to 8% at most.

font_pairings.note: A high-contrast serif for a title on a spread and a plain humanist body.
A light serif for a quiet caption.
A geometric sans for a clean tag row.

typography.tracking: Display takes +0.02em; the tag row takes +0.06em.
hierarchy_rules: Use italic for a product name.

color.palette_structure: Pale marble white with one blush, one eucalyptus green, oak brown and a dark coffee accent.
color.contrast_rules: Text on white holds at least 14:1; blush and eucalyptus carry props, tags and fills, not small text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat, light fills; photos show marble, linen or oak with a soft grain; no gradient on chrome.
color.light_and_shadow: Soft window light from one side; shadows are long, pale and 20% to 30% opaque; no flash.

materiality.surface_simulation: A tabletop of marble, linen or oak seen from above.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px #E5E2DB line between cards; no border on photos.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; props cast a soft shadow of 8px to 20px blur at 20% to 30% opacity.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Fine outline icons at 24px with a 1.5px stroke: heart, bookmark, tag and share.
ornamentation_details.illustration: No drawn art; props such as flowers, a cup, a notebook and sunglasses tell the story.

motion.transition_physics: Cards fade in at 300ms with a 8px rise; carousel slides move at 350ms; no motion inside the photo.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts the photo by 2px with a soft shadow; a tap on a tag opens its feed in 250ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels order, calm and a small wish to own the same pleasant things.

avoid_when: The subject is a person or an event with motion.
The product is large and cannot sit on a table.
The brief needs a raw, documentary look.

modifiers.how: Shoot at oblique angles with a hard flash and keep the clutter.
Fix one ground and one accent for all frames and lay them in a strict 3-column grid.
Apply a matte warm preset and lift the blacks.

pack.why: A fine, even line family that suits quiet captions and tag rows on pale photos.

ground.why: The ground is the table: a pale linen or marble surface seen from above.
